title: Jazz Ltd. in Chicago and Big Sid Catlett
summary: Moore played Jazz Ltd. with Big Sid Catlett, whom he admired.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who is it -- Ruth Rhinehart, she's like a --
She's the owner of the place, besides Bill Rhinehart was the owner also there, the couple that --
What was the name of the place?
Jazz, Ltd. Grand Avenue and State Street. On that job we had Big Sid Catlett.

He was such a wonderful musician. Every time he played solo, I just listened to Big Sid and really sold that charm that he had on the drums. I knew Big Sid in New York as well quite a long time. He was playing with different bands at

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

the Savoy and I always watched him, but never had the opportunity to work with him and when he was contracted to play Jazz, Ltd. we loved to Big Sid. Unfortunately he wasn't around too long with the rest of us. Big Sid passed away a few years after that.
